# Neptune Mountaineering

> > Boulder's premier outdoor retailer since 1977, specializing in climbing, backcountry skiing, and mountaineering gear with the largest climbing selection in the US.

Founded by Gary Neptune in 1973 and now woman-owned under Maile Spung's leadership, Neptune Mountaineering serves Colorado's outdoor community with premium brands including La Sportiva, Mammut, Petzl, Black Diamond, and Scarpa. The store features a mountaineering museum, community café, and The Neptune LAB incubator for emerging outdoor brands.

## Key Topics

## Climbing Gear & Equipment

- [Largest Selection of Climbing Gear in the US | Neptune](https://neptunemountaineering.com/collections/climb): Comprehensive climbing gear catalog: harnesses, ropes, cams from top brands
- [Men's Climbing Shoes](https://neptunemountaineering.com/collections/mens-climbing-shoes): Men's climbing shoes from La Sportiva, Scarpa, Tenaya, OCUN
- [Climbing Ropes, Slings, Bags & Packs | Neptune](https://neptunemountaineering.com/collections/ropes-bags): Dynamic & static climbing ropes from Beal, Edelrid, Sterling, Mammut
- [Static Rope](https://neptunemountaineering.com/collections/static-rope): Static climbing ropes from Petzl, Sterling, Edelrid for canyoneering
- [Chalk, Chalk Bags & Brushes](https://neptunemountaineering.com/collections/chalk-bags): Climbing chalk, bags & brushes from Friction Labs, Black Diamond, Metolius
- [Pro Guide Lite Belay Device](https://neptunemountaineering.com/products/pro-guide-lite-belay-device): Wild Country lightweight belay device with guide mode for alpine climbing
- [TX Guide - Men's](https://neptunemountaineering.com/products/tx-guide): La Sportiva TX Guide approach shoes with Vibram MegaGrip for alpine terrain
